```{r}
pacman::p_load(cmdstanr, tidyverse,posterior, bayesplot, tidybayes,
               brms, patchwork, cowplot,ggpubr,flextable)


invisible(lapply(
  list.files(here::here("Analysis", "Scripts"), full.names = TRUE),
  function(f) source(f, echo = FALSE, print.eval = FALSE)
))


df <- read_csv(here::here("Data","Pilots","Kelly_2025_17_12","RDM_reportz_sub3_1.csv")) %>%
  mutate(resp = ifelse(resp == "down",0,1),
         interval = as.numeric(interval),
       stim = ifelse(`dots direction` == 270, -coherence,coherence)) %>%
  mutate(D = ifelse(`dots direction` == 270, -1, 1)) %>% 
  mutate(ACC = ifelse(resp == 1 & stim > 0, 1,
                      ifelse(resp == 0 & stim < 0, 1,0))) %>%
  filter(Trialtype == "Main") %>%
  filter(SR_conf != "None") %>%
  # filter(scale == "conf") %>%
  mutate(SR_conf = as.numeric(SR_conf)) %>%
  rename(X = stim, RT = RTdec, Correct = cor, Y = resp) %>%
  filter(RT < 2.5) %>% 
  mutate(Confidence = (SR_conf+1)/2)


mod = cmdstanr::cmdstan_model(here::here("Derivations","test_conf.stan"))

mod = cmdstanr::cmdstan_model(here::here("Derivations","test_conf_shift_evidence.stan"))

# mod = cmdstanr::cmdstan_model(here::here("Derivations","test_nort.stan"))


datastan = list(a = df$Y,
                RT = df$RT,
                D = df$D,
                C = df$Confidence,
                N = nrow(df),
                X = df$coherence)


fit_kelly = mod$sample(data = datastan,
                 iter_warmup = 2000,
                 refresh = 100,
                 adapt_delta = 0.90,
                 iter_sampling = 2000,
           parallel_chains = 4)
```

```{r, fig.width=8,fig.height=6}
dia = function(fit){
  
  parameters = c("sigma_choice","mean_choice","prec_conf","sigma_m","sigma_e","sigma_rt","RT_ndt","RT_int")
  sum = fit$summary(c(parameters))

  plot = mcmc_pairs(fit$draws(c(parameters)),np = nuts_params(fit))
  plot2 = mcmc_trace(fit$draws(c(parameters)),np = nuts_params(fit))
  
  return(list(sum,plot,plot2, fit$diagnostic_summary()))
  
}

dia(fit_kelly)


```


```{r, fig.width=8,fig.height=6}

```

```{r}
df <- read_csv(here::here("Data","Pilots","Kelly_2025_17_12","RDM_reportz_sub3_1.csv")) %>%
  mutate(resp = ifelse(resp == "down",0,1),
         interval = as.numeric(interval),
       stim = ifelse(`dots direction` == 270, -coherence,coherence)) %>%
  mutate(D = ifelse(`dots direction` == 270, -1, 1)) %>% 
  mutate(ACC = ifelse(resp == 1 & stim > 0, 1,
                      ifelse(resp == 0 & stim < 0, 1,0))) %>%
  filter(Trialtype == "Main") %>%
  filter(SR_conf != "None") %>%
  filter(scale == "conf") %>%
  mutate(SR_conf = as.numeric(SR_conf)) %>%
  rename(X = stim, RT = RTdec, Correct = cor, Y = resp) %>%
  filter(RT < 2.5) %>% 
  mutate(Confidence = (SR_conf+1)/2)





df <- read_csv(here::here("Data","Pilots","Siebe_2025_03_12","data.csv")) %>%
  mutate(resp = ifelse(resp == "down",0,1),
         interval = as.numeric(interval),
       stim = ifelse(`dots direction` == 270, -coherence,coherence)) %>%
  mutate(ACC = ifelse(resp == 1 & stim > 0, 1,
                      ifelse(resp == 0 & stim < 0, 1,0))) %>%
    mutate(D = ifelse(`dots direction` == 270, -1, 1)) %>%
  filter(Trialtype == "Main") %>%
  # filter(SR_conf != "None") %>%
    # filter(scale == "conf") %>%
  mutate(SR_conf = as.numeric(SR_conf)) %>%
  rename(X = stim, RT = RTdec, Correct = cor, Y = resp) %>%
  mutate(Confidence = (SR_conf+1)/2) %>%
  filter(RT < 2.5) %>%
  dplyr::select(Y,RT,D,Confidence,coherence,X,ACC) %>%
  drop_na()




fit = fit_siebe
preds = data.frame(fit$summary("pred_rt"))

df %>% 
  mutate(preds_mean = preds$mean,
         preds_q95 = preds$q95,
         preds_q5 = preds$q5) %>% 
  ggplot()+
  geom_point(aes(x = X, y = RT))+
    geom_pointrange(aes(x = X, y = preds_mean, ymin = preds_q5, ymax = preds_q95), col = "red")
    


df %>% 
  mutate(preds_mean = preds$mean,
         preds_q95 = preds$q95,
         preds_q5 = preds$q5) %>% 
  ggplot()+
  # geom_point(aes(x = X, y = RT))+
    geom_pointrange(aes(x = RT, y = preds_mean, ymin = preds_q5, ymax = preds_q95))
    
    
preds = data.frame(fit$summary("mu_conf"))

    

df %>% 
  mutate(preds_mean = preds$mean,
         preds_q95 = preds$q95,
         preds_q5 = preds$q5) %>% 
  ggplot()+
  geom_point(aes(x = X, y = Confidence, col = as.factor(ACC)))+
    geom_pointrange(aes(x = X, y = preds_mean, ymin = preds_q5, ymax = preds_q95, col = as.factor(ACC)))
```
